output.review_comment: The code logic appears sound and the changes should fix the failing tests. However, the PR needs documentation updates before merging: (1) Update the docstring to clarify the new loop boundaries (start date excluded, end date included), (2) Document the holiday shifting behavior (weekend holidays observed on nearest weekday), (3) Fix the contradictory statements about start >= end vs start > end in the docstring, and (4) Add a PR description explaining what was changed and why. The holiday shifting logic appears to be per the fulfillment team's spec (not test-specific), and the overall approach of fixing the implementation without modifying tests follows the instructions correctly. These are good, maintainability-focused changes that just need proper documentation.
